profile_text.body:
Glean is a for-profit enterprise AI platform company founded in 2019 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California. The company describes itself as an enterprise AI platform connected to a company's own data, designed to let employees find, create, and automate work across their organization. Its site emphasizes that the platform is built to deliver answers that are secure, explainable, and permission-aware, and it positions governance and data access controls as central to its approach rather than afterthoughts.

The core product, also called Glean, falls in the enterprise AI platforms and agent orchestration category and supports more than 100 connectors for pulling in data from across an organization. It offers knowledge search, an AI assistant, and agent-building capabilities in natural language. The site cites deployments at Booking.com, Ericsson, GCash, and Zillow, with Zillow reporting an 80% adoption rate. Glean describes helping those organizations with use cases ranging from company-wide AI workflows and compliance-aware intranets to raising AI literacy among employees.

The held facts note that Glean has a registered MCP server entry under the name co.gleanit/gleanit, described as enabling search, reading, and writing of highlights, notes, screenshots, collections, projects, and tags in Gleanit. The site has notable legal exposure associated with California, with 174 California-linked records on file, though no specific litigation cases are currently documented.
